[P2] Require coverage for decider configuration overrides

Every decider fixture leaves `model` unset, and every decider operation omits `options.name`. Replacing these selections with their defaults therefore leaves the assertions unchanged, although callers would lose configured model selection and checkpoint names. The override tests exercise `llm`, whose implementation is separate. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the testing design and require assertions that the configured model reaches the transport and a custom decider name appears in execution history, or remove these options from the initial API.
